title: Praline — Bakery & More
summary: A complete brand identity for an Erbil bakery, connecting its products and personality through a cohesive visual language.

blocks.body:
Praline is a bakery brand in Erbil, Iraq, offering a range of baked goods and desserts.

The objective was to create a distinctive identity that could communicate the brand's character consistently across its visual touchpoints.

The process began with research into the target audience, competitors, and the bakery's environment and product offering.

These findings informed the creative brief and helped establish a clear direction for the brand identity.

The identity was developed around the idea of giving everyday bakery experiences a recognizable and memorable character.

The tagline, "A Story To Tell", became an important part of the brand's communication, connecting its products with a broader narrative.

The logo and supporting visual elements were designed to create consistency across branded materials and customer-facing applications.

The identity was extended across marketing communication and branded materials, creating a coherent presence across different formats.

The objective was to ensure that the visual character of Praline remained recognizable wherever customers encountered the brand.

items.label: Deliverables
